summary: Iteration 586 - Async Job Polling & Elite Glass UI Testing. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified with glass styling, approved reports panel, and async PDF download with polling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Async job polling for daily summary draft and PDF generation is working correctly. Backend returns 202 with job_id, polling reaches completed state with results. Glass UI styling (elite-glass-panel, elite-glass-sidebar, elite-shell-header, elite-processing-glow) is present in HTML and CSS. Approved reports panel at /admin/operational-intelligence shows reports with PDF download buttons that use async polling. Redis is intentionally DISABLED - cache_backend metadata shows memory fallback.

async_daily_summary_draft.details: POST /api/daily-reports/summary/draft returns 202 with job_id, status=queued, kind=daily_summary_draft. Polling /api/jobs/{job_id}/status reaches completed state with summary_text result.

async_pdf_generation.details: GET /api/daily-reports/{report_id}/pdf returns 202 with job_id, kind=daily_report_pdf. Polling reaches completed state with download_url. PDF download via /api/jobs/{job_id}/result returns valid PDF content.

job_polling_endpoint.details: GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/status returns queued/processing/completed states. Returns 404 for nonexistent jobs. cache_backend metadata shows backend=memory, redis_active=false.

approved_reports_list.details: GET /api/daily-reports/approved returns list of approved reports with items array. Requires admin auth (returns 401 without token).

glass_ui_styling.details: elite-glass-panel, elite-glass-sidebar, elite-shell-header, elite-processing-glow classes present in HTML. CSS includes vendor-prefixed backdrop-filter with @supports fallbacks.

approved_reports_panel_ui.details: DrV2ApprovedReportsPanel renders at /admin/operational-intelligence with data-testid='approved-daily-reports-panel-admin'. Table shows reports with PDF download buttons. Clicking PDF button shows loading spinner during async job.

photo_upload_per_photo_callback.details: PhotoUpload.jsx has onPhotoReady callback that fires for each photo as it finishes uploading, not waiting for full batch.

pulsing_glow_animation.details: DailySummaryAssist.jsx applies elite-processing-glow class when status='building'. CSS defines elitePulseGlow animation with box-shadow and transform.

redis_disabled_memory_fallback.details: Job status responses include cache_backend={backend:'memory', redis_active:false} confirming Redis is disabled with memory fallback.
